method.selection: Highest August-September net profit; outcomes cut off October 1. Also report full-history winner as explicitly hindsight. No selection on November 18-20 outcomes.
method.limitations: All dates, including the former fresh sample, have already been inspected. This is exploratory reused-data evidence, not independent validation. Original reference reconstruction and exhaustive OHLC engine are inherited from archived study. Unknown outcomes excluded; DD excludes floating losses. No new market data. All setups simulated independently, without margin, concurrent-risk, or daily-loss limits.
method.sizing: Historical contract assumption: 100 oz, .01 lot minimum/step. Strict two-leg sizing skips whole setup if either leg cannot be sized. This differs from second-only fallback and is not a broker-fill replay.
method.costs: Sensitivity only: 0.20 or 0.50 total round-trip gold price-unit cost plus $7 per lot round trip. Not observed broker spreads/fees. Costs applied to known resolved legs only.
